messages:
mira: Heads-up — i'm seeing warmup probe storms on mixed-GPU nodes when seq-len buckets shift rapidly. Latency spikes and lots of prefill churn.

sam: Do you have a snippet of logs or a quick trace? sounds like prefill eviction + probe retry interaction. can you paste a couple lines?

mira: pasted logs:
```
[12:17:03] prefill: tenant=acme seq=512 target_bucket=long probe_id=0x7f
[12:17:03] evict: kvcache tenant=acme reason=mem_pressure freed=24MB
[12:17:03] probe_retry: tenant=acme backoff_ms=0 next_probe_in=5ms
[12:17:04] prefill: tenant=beta seq=16 target_bucket=short probe_id=0x9a
```
Also current config is global probe_backoff_ms=5, max_prefill_retries=3.

kai: we intentionally have backoff, but it's global per-machine rather than per-tenant. that causes cross-tenant interference when one noisy tenant oscillates buckets.

jorge: idea: per-tenant probe budgets (warmup credits). allocate credits by SLA tier and refill at a rate proportional to reserved qps. if credits exhausted, fall back to no-prefill for that tenant for X sec.

anya: sounds reasonable. caveat: cold-start long seqs (>> typical median) can still blow credits quickly. maybe fast-path for tiny seqs (<32) and a separate long-seq admission controller that samples instead of full prefill.

sam: sketch of adaptive rule:
```
# per-request
want_prefill = expected_cost < token_budget && tenant_credits > 0
prefill_prob = min(1, desired_prefill_rate / (observed_token_rate + 1e-6))
# decrement tenant_credits by prefill_cost on successful prefill
```
This makes probe frequency scale with observed workload and limits tenant impact.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout: kernel-autotune/v3 -> dev-cluster at 12:34 UTC :rocket:

kai: we should also add eviction hysteresis: avoid evicting KV entries until low-percentile usage holds for 30s. prevents flip-flop when seq-len distribution oscillates.

mira: Can we tag metrics/traces with probe_reason, tenant_sla, seq_bucket so Console can filter and we can run retros on which tenants cause storms?

sam: yes — will add those fields. also plan to emit cost_per_probe_tokens so we can tie warmup to token economics.

jorge: next steps: i'll draft a short RFC with sim of mixed tenants (one bursty long-seq tenant + several short median tenants) and run perf sims. include config knobs: credit_rate, credit_burst, eviction_hysteresis.

mira: :thumbsup: thanks. can we do a quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to review sims and decide default config?

kai: added to calendar. ping if you want me to run a live flamegraph while we repro the storm.
